annotations.title: Cofounder Equity Split and ARR Multiple Calculator

description: Splits founder equity from weighted contribution scores (product and IP 40%, distribution 35%, commitment 25%) after the option pool and Founder Institute FAST advisor grants, and applies a heuristic SaaS and AI-native ARR multiple. Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/cofounder-equity-valuation. The multiple is a rule of thumb from the web page, not a market valuation. Illustrative, not legal advice.

arr.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

cofounders.description: Each founder scored 0 to 100 on three axes. Omit to use the web calculator example of two founders.

fast_stage.description: Company stage for the FAST grant. Web default startup.

gross_margin_pct.description: Gross margin in percent. Web default 76.
gross_margin_pct.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

growth_pct.description: Year over year growth in percent. Web default 140.
growth_pct.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

ndr_pct.description: Net dollar retention in percent. Web default 122.
ndr_pct.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

num_advisors.description: Number of FAST advisors. Web default 2.

option_pool_pct.description: Employee option pool reserve, in percent. Web default 10.
option_pool_pct.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default
